name: VS Code Extension & IDE Integration
reconciliationNote: VS Code extension implemented under src/extension/ as a thin adapter over the existing tool core (no analysis logic duplicated). extension.js is the only module that touches the live vscode API and lazily requires it; all logic lives in vscode-agnostic units under src/extension/lib (aqt-service, diagnostics-provider, code-actions-provider, webview-panel, config, status-bar) so it is verifiable offline under `node test/run.js`. package.json contributes 5 commands, editor context menus, and 7 configuration properties. Added test/__tests__/extension.test.js (22 tests) covering config normalization + severity floor, diagnostics mapping (1-based -> 0-based, severity map, grouping), code actions (fixable-only quick fixes + doc actions), status-bar rendering, webview HTML rendering + HTML escaping (XSS guard), and the AqtService bridge with injected fakes (analyze/dedup/sort, groupByFile, fix delegation, linter detection). Full suite: `node test/run.js` -> 112 passing / 0 failing. P3-T008 packaging is config + documented layouts (.vscodeignore, README Packaging section, vsce package/publish scripts); actual marketplace publish requires a publisher token and is left as an operator step.
